name: 25550 · Pt Pleasant, WV
findings: ZIP 25550 (Pt Pleasant) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 25550 (Pt Pleasant) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 25550 (Pt Pleasant) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
